$comment: Known browser-matrix failures (TASK-OSS-P5-03). A listed cell runs as `test.fail()`: Playwright fails the run if it UNEXPECTEDLY PASSES, so this file can only shrink. It is a ratchet, not a skip list -- the cell still runs, still costs wall-clock, and still reports.
measuredOn: chromium, firefox and webkit. TASK-N1-O2 ran the full six-condition sweep on firefox 151.0 and webkit 26.5: firefox reproduced all 46 entries, webkit 44. TASK-N1-O3 then fixed all 46 and the file is empty. It is still a ratchet, not a clean slate: an entry may only be added back with a measured number, a reason and an owner.
policy: Entries are removed when fixed and never added without a measured number and a reason. Adding one is a decision with an owner; removing one is the point.
closedBy: TASK-N1-O3. All 46 entries -- 28 WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size and 18 SC 1.4.10 Reflow -- were closed and removed after the cell measured green on the chromium lane. Root causes, in the order they fan out: (1) the 24px target floor became a token (--dz-control-target-min) plus two utilities in packages/core/src/styles/base.css, applied at the variants layer; (2) the native <input> inside every composite field was its own text line, ~21px, inside a 38px shell, so `.dz-field-input-reset`/`.dz-native-input` now stretch to the shell; (3) 31 references to `--dz-spacing-N-N` across 15 files named a token the scale does not emit (it emits `--dz-spacing-N_N`), so that padding was silently dropped and rows collapsed onto their text; (4) DzLightbox bound tv() slot FUNCTIONS instead of calling them, so the whole component rendered unclassed; (5) a harness defect -- the zoom-400 condition measured min-content width, not reflow, because Storybook`s `layout: centered` never gives the story a 320px containing block; (6) five story fixtures hard-coded a width wider than 320px. Full account: docs/program-2026-09/reports/N1-O3-wcag-fixes-handoff.md.
